requested_by: Omri 2026-09-28 ('yes - run it'): decide every open component of the algorithm (filter, clustering, use of the Dawid-Skene estimates within and between groups, within- and between-group weights, where the binary tail marks and where the continuous matrices are used); add the three digit features to every bank; neutralize position and use L-SML; show the methods against Mind the Gap on ProcessBench; end with ONE candidate to freeze and test on the new benchmarks, and an algorithm with clear stages for the advisors.
evidence_status: Development data (PRMBench/ProcessBench already inspected). The selection below is selection on development outcomes; the frozen candidate's untouched test is the new benchmarks.

algorithm_stages.0_representation: FIXED. Per answer: z-score of every channel (continuous matrix); top-20% tail marks per channel (binary; random-tie marks for the estimators, tie-aware centred marks for clustering)
algorithm_stages.1_filter: DECIDED (Steps 451, 455, 456): Dawid-Skene on the binary marks, keep channel iff pi_hat > 0.5. Band rule rejected (Step 456). Digits leave the keep/drop decisions of the 13 channels unchanged in 5/5 folds (checked before this protocol).
algorithm_stages.2_position: TO DECIDE: P0 raw (learn and score on the bank); P1 learn without position (every label-free estimate - filter, partition, merge, within and between weights - on the position-adjusted bank, then applied to the ORIGINAL channels); P2 full (learn and score on the position-adjusted bank). Position-adjusted bank = V minus the label-free mean by (answer length, step index) on the PRMBench fit-fold steps, re-standardized within answer (stage-B definition).
algorithm_stages.3_clustering: DECIDED (Steps 455, 456): L-SML partition on the tie-aware centred binary marks (tail_calib_common.lsml_fit_scaled), then the absorption merge (lsml_merge_step.absorb_merge, rho < 0.5, never below 3 groups). Correlation matrix of the marks for the merge.
algorithm_stages.4_within_group_weights: TO DECIDE: EQ (mean of the members); SML (L-SML's own within-group SML on the continuous values, small-m guard: a 3-member group gets equal SD weights); HEM (from the latent-group EM on the channel marks with the merged groups: w_i = max(0, log(e1(1-e0)/(e0(1-e1)))), how well channel i tracks its group's latent state; groups with < 3 members or all-zero weights: equal)
algorithm_stages.5_between_group_weights: TO DECIDE: EQ (equal); SML (SML on the answer-standardized group scores, small-m guard, oriented by Spearman with q15_H1 on the fit rows; for SML within it is exactly L-SML with the merged partition, fit_fusion_weights groups=); DSM (MLE weights max(0, log(psi eta/((1-psi)(1-eta)))) from Dawid-Skene on top-20% random-tie marks of the group scores, key default_rng(20260929).random((steps, 13))[:, :G], needs >= 3 groups; with EQ within this is exactly stage-B2 B_sml__merge); HEM (MLE weights from the latent-group EM's group estimate: accuracy of the group's latent state, oriented to the state in which its members vote 'error'; groups with < 3 members: mean of the members' marginal estimates)
algorithm_stages.binary_vs_continuous: Binary marks for every ESTIMATE (filter, partition, merge, DSM, HEM); continuous values for what is COMBINED (channel values, group scores) and for SML weights.

group_score: column g = answer re-standardized within-weighted combination of the member channels (EQ: mean = er_stage_b.group_scores); the final score = group scores times between weights normalized to sum |w| = 1 (SML/SML: the L-SML channel weights)

banks.B16: B13 + digit_alternative, digit_spread, digit_alternative_innovation (masked per-answer z; active on every step)
banks.B51: 52-channel step pool minus the constant channel
banks.note: digit features do not use disagreement with the chosen token; their scope under the 2026-09-17 exclusion is Omri's decision; banks with and without digits are both reported

arms_per_bank.P{0,1,2}__BASE: DS filter then plain average of the survivors (P0 = the reference; P1 = survivors from the position-adjusted bank, averaged on the original channels; P2 = averaged on the position-adjusted bank)
arms_per_bank.P{0,1,2}__{EQ,SML,HEM}_{EQ,SML,DSM,HEM}: the 12 fusion rules (within_between) under each position mode = 36
arms_per_bank.P0__ORACLE: LABEL-USING ceiling: EQ within, MLE between weights from the TRUE group-mark accuracies on the fit folds (= stage-B2 B_oracle__merge); reference only, never a candidate
arms_per_bank.references: ct7, fam421, step_index; ProcessBench: Mind the Gap published Table 3 and our reproduction (results/mtg_reproduction_v1, argmax rule, same traces) per cell, not re-run

endpoints: PRMBench within-answer AUC (selection endpoint), official PRMScore; ProcessBench gate-free SLA per cell and macro 8 (q4/q8 share answers). Beside, never used to rescue.
folds: eval k, calibration (k+1)%5 for the PRMScore threshold only (same fold-k model), learning on the other three; write-once; failed fits unscored (no fallback); an arm with any failed fold is excluded from contrasts and selection
uncertainty: paired source-group bootstrap, 50,000 draws (seed 20260927), 95% intervals; per-arm draws on the common full-coverage population, pair differences from the same draws

selection_rule_frozen.variants: the 36 fusion arms and P1__BASE, P2__BASE (38 per bank); ALL_equal and ORACLE are not candidates
selection_rule_frozen.loss_on_bank: 95% interval of (variant - P0__BASE) on PRMBench within-AUC entirely below 0
selection_rule_frozen.eligible: full coverage on all 8 banks and a loss on none
selection_rule_frozen.candidate: among eligible variants that win on at least 5 of the 8 banks, the one with the highest mean within-AUC over the 8 banks; if none qualifies, the candidate is P0__BASE (DS filter then plain average)
selection_rule_frozen.also_reported: the eligible variant with the highest 8-bank mean regardless of wins, and the best variant overall

decisions_derived_for_the_advisor_table: per bank and 8-bank mean: position (P0/P1/P2 at the candidate's fusion rule and at P0__BASE), within (EQ/SML/HEM at the candidate's other choices), between (EQ/SML/DSM/HEM at the candidate's other choices), digits (with vs without at the same arm). Each with its paired interval.
contrasts: per bank: every arm vs P0__BASE; P1/P2 fusion arms vs their own BASE and vs the same rule at P0; digits: B16-B13, B23-B20, B35-B32, B54-B51 for every arm; candidate and P0__BASE vs ct7 and fam421
nulls_and_robustness: within-answer label shuffle and same-length whole-answer label swap (200 permutations, seeds 11/12) and concentration (share from the top 1% in the direction of the mean, the gain without them, 5%-trimmed mean, per-fold) for: candidate vs P0__BASE per bank (if the candidate is not P0__BASE), the best eligible variant vs P0__BASE per bank, P1__BASE and P2__BASE vs P0__BASE, P0/P1 SML_SML vs P0__BASE (Omri's 'neutralize position and use L-SML'), and the four digit contrasts at P0__BASE
activity_records: per bank, fold and learning bank (raw / position-adjusted): survivors and dropped channels; partition before/after the merge, merged or not, merge log; L-SML small-m guard events (within groups of 3, cross stage with 3 groups) for every SML fit; DSM failures (< 3 groups) and groups with weight 0; HEM groups with < 3 members, latent re-orientations, groups with equal within weights, convergence. No result is attributed to a component that did not act.
diagnostics_label_using_for_diagnosis_on: channel pi_hat vs true (DS filter); group-level DSM and HEM psi/eta/pi vs the true accuracy of the group marks; estimated prevalence (DS channel, DS group, HEM) vs true (~0.14); shift of the shared channels' pi_hat and prevalence when the digits are added (same fold); leave-one-group-out: Dawid-Skene refit without each merged group's channels - label-free change of prevalence and of the other channels' pi_hat, and (label-using) whether the prevalence error and the pi_hat error fall
